# Educational Links of Interest

## 🤖 Artificial Intelligence for Education

**MagicSchool AI**

[https://www.magicschool.ai/](https://www.magicschool.ai/){target="_blank"}
Artificial intelligence platform for teachers; helps create automated educational resources and experiences, reducing teaching workload.

---

**Google NotebookLM**

[https://notebooklm.google.com/](https://notebooklm.google/){target="_blank"}
Google Labs AI for note-taking, research, and organizing information with documents, visual summaries, and collaboration.

---

**Lumivara**

[https://lumivara.at/](https://lumivara.at/){target="_blank"}
Educational platform with AI that helps generate interactive materials, questionnaires and summaries.

---

**Kimi-ppt (Kimi Slides)**

[https://ppt.ai/es/kimi-ppt](https://ppt.ai/es/kimi-ppt){target="_blank"}
AI that creates automatic presentations from text makes it easy to quickly generate slides for teachers and students.

---

## 🔬 Natural Sciences - Simulators and Virtual Laboratories

**PhET Interactive Simulations**

[https://phet.colorado.edu/](https://phet.colorado.edu/){target="_blank"}
Free and interactive simulators for physics, chemistry, biology and mathematics experiments developed by the University of Colorado Boulder.

---

**ChemCollective**
[https://chemcollective.org/](https://chemcollective.org/){target="_blank"}
Virtual laboratories and guided activities to teach chemistry, with simulations and interactive exercises.

---

**Algodoo**

[https://www.algodoo.com/](https://www.algodoo.com/){target="_blank"}
2D physics sandbox to experiment and simulate physical phenomena through visual and creative simulation, free.

---

**Lab Simulations OER – Mines LibGuides**

[https://libguides.mines.edu/oer/simulationslabs](https://libguides.mines.edu/oer/simulationslabs){target="_blank"}
Guide to open virtual laboratories and simulations, useful for STEM teaching.

---

**Climate Change Simulator**

[https://www.climateinteractive.org/world-climate-simulation-spanish/](https://www.climateinteractive.org/world-climate-simulation-spanish/){target="_blank"}
World Climate Simulation is an in-person role-playing game about the UN climate change negotiations. Through the simulation, participants explore the speed and work required by nations to address global climate change.

---

**Scientific Models Simulator**  

[https://www.netlogo.org/](https://www.netlogo.org/){target="_blank"}  
NetLogo is the world's most widely used agent-based modeling platform, designed with a *low threshold, high ceiling* philosophy. This means that primary school students can learn to create their first models, while the same platform drives cutting-edge research. NetLogo has been used in over 10,000 scientific publications and is used in thousands of classrooms around the world.
